user.title: Set up Steuertage
user.description: Choose a person, its work location and the automatic-detection threshold. Homeoffice and an external work calendar are optional; their settings appear in the following step only when enabled. The default calendar follows the Home Assistant user linked to the selected Person in Home Assistant.

homeoffice.title: Homeoffice detection
homeoffice.description: Select the home zone and the device tracker used for Homeoffice detection.

work_calendar.title: Work calendar
work_calendar.description: Choose the Home Assistant calendar that contains work appointments. Timed and all-day entries are supported.
